Losing spot instances

If you're losing spot instances, you may be using an instance type that has a high reclaim rate. Consider changing your instance types. If you're on AWS, use the Spot Instance Advisor to see how frequently each instance type gets reclaimed. Or you can simply stop using spot instances. You may also want to review our spot instance recommendations.
